decisive_spans.text: Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene (p.E643del) identified by whole-exon sequencing

response.rationale: The presence of a 'Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene identified by whole-exon sequencing' is a direct and specific support for TBK1-associated frontotemporal dementia (D2). Other candidates are contradicted by this finding or do not have such strong, specific support.
